subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------INFO.CON.
description: Chart on book p. 33 (SD(SY)-11). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; INFO-CON (information convergence) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT-DYM (thrust continuance dynamics), T-V-IMP and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From T-V-IMP: TRS (transition). From IST-S-ALGN: RE-DIFF, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From RE-DIFF: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: SPTC-D (spectacle diversion) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From RT-ALGN: RT-OP (reality options). From RT-OP: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: SOC-RT (social reality).
